title.text: RasterSong: a redesign of the editor

p1.text:
Priorities
1. Transport sits under the preview, next to where you work.
2. Readable graph: 12-13px node text, a category color strip on top of each node.
3. Inspector follows the selection: node, graph item, track.
4. Resources show Media and Graphs together, no tab switch.
5. Destructive actions (remove track) move into menus.
6. Status bar teaches the hidden gestures (Alt, Shift, Ctrl+drag).
7. Wire probe views on a wrap-around drum: scroll it, the middle one shows.

p3.text:
Tempo mode
- Tempo, beats per bar, first beat and Metronome sit in one group attached to the Time/Tempo switch; in Time mode the group collapses away.
- Two-tier ruler: bars bold on top, beats small below; every other bar shaded.
- Amber marker on the ruler = first beat.
- Snap and loop regions follow the beat grid; Shift drags freely.
- Transport under the preview reads bar.beat large, seconds small, with a beat light.
- File > Settings > Project edits the same fields.

p2.text: Kept as-is: every feature in docs/app.md. Nothing is cut; the redesign changes where it lives and how it reads.
